Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: No service between West Hampstead and Stanmore due to late finish of engineering work. Tickets being accepted on London buses, Mildmay line, Elizabeth line and Thameslink railway services. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

The 0552 first train from Willesden Junction to Clapham Junction starts from Shepherd's Bush at 0600 and the 0608 second train from Willesden Junction to Clapham Junction does not run. Use the next service at 0623 or local bus routes 220 or 228. The 0611 train from Stratford to Clapham Junction will start from Shepherd's Bush at 07:01. (Train normally runs from Stratford, but NLL service will not run)
